subject: Use detection model to estimate site-level abundance (and confidence interval)

messages.author: d640f02d29e7de63
messages.subject: Use detection model to estimate site-level abundance (and confidence interval)
parts:
Hello,

I used a dependent double observer protocol and gmultmix to model detection probability of several duck species (output below is for American green-winged teal) with no covariates. After backtransformmng the detection estimates, the detection probability is 0.793 with a SE of 0.018. I would like to use this model to estimate abundance (with confidence intervals) at each site, but I can't find an example online or in AHM. Ranef() seems to produce the estimates, but not confidence intervals. And predict(), which does produce confidence intervals, is meant for prediction in relation to covariates, not at the site level.

I'd appreciate any suggestions, many thanks.

Mark B.


> AGWT

Call:
gmultmix(lambdaformula = ~1, phiformula = ~1, pformula = ~1, 
    data = umfGMM, control = list(trace = TRUE))

Abundance:
 Estimate     SE   z   P(>|z|)
    -1.07 0.0333 -32 1.51e-224

Detection:
 Estimate    SE    z  P(>|z|)
     1.35 0.108 12.4 2.34e-35

AIC: 4891.329 

bt <- backTransform(linearComb(AGWT, c(1), type="det")); bt

Backtransformed linear combination(s) of Detection estimate(s)

 Estimate     SE LinComb (Intercept)
    0.793 0.0178    1.35           1

Transformation: logistic

messages.author: 403be63af7ebf220
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Use detection model to estimate site-level abundance (and confidence interval)
parts:
Hi Mark,

You should be able to get confidence intervals using:

re <- ranef(AGWT)
confint(re)



Richard
